settings.heading: A Walvis Bay family business, led by Tuli
settings.body_content:
Two Stars Tour & Safari is run by Tulimeke (Tuli) and her team in Walvis Bay. We are a women-led local business, registered with the Namibia Tourism Board (#TSO01736), and we take guests to the places we know best: the flamingo lagoon and Pink Salt Lake, the dunes of Sandwich Harbour, Swakopmund, Dune 7 and Spitzkoppe.

We keep every group to a maximum of four guests per vehicle. That means no rushing, long photo stops, and time to ask questions. Many of our guests mention Tuli and the team by name in their reviews, and that is exactly the kind of day we are aiming for.

We focus on coastal and desert day tours that feel personal, well paced and grounded in local knowledge. When you travel with Two Stars, you travel with people who call this coast home.

settings.section_title: Why we are based in Walvis Bay
settings.body_content:
Walvis Bay and Swakopmund sit where the Atlantic meets the Namib Desert. That means flamingo lagoons, pink salt pans, windswept coastal roads and the dunes of Sandwich Harbour dropping toward the ocean, all within a short drive.

Living here lets us plan around weather windows and the best light, and choose the stops that make a day feel complete.

fields.title: Sandwich Harbour Small-Group 4x4 Tour from Walvis Bay
fields.content:
Your guides are Tuli and her women-led local team, a family business that takes only four guests per vehicle. That small size is the point: nobody is rushed, and there is room to stop wherever the light is good.

We plan the day around photography, with long, unhurried stops rather than quick drive-bys. You visit the Walvis Bay Lagoon for flamingos, the Pink Salt Lake, and then Sandwich Harbour, where the dunes meet the Atlantic.

Along the way there are scenic photo stops as well as light snacks and refreshments.

fields.title: Walvis Bay Flamingo & Pink Salt Lake Tour
fields.content:
This is the relaxed way to see Walvis Bay: a shorter outing built around birdlife, the Pink Salt Lake and easy photo stops, led by Tuli and her women-led local team.

It centres on the Walvis Bay Lagoon and the Pink Salt Lake, with few transitions and no rush, so it suits families, birders and anyone who wants a lighter day. We take a maximum of four guests per vehicle, which leaves time to wait for the right shot.

fields.title: Swakopmund City & Dune 7 Day Tour
fields.content:
Town and desert in one day. Tuli and her women-led local team take you through Swakopmund's landmarks and history, then on to Dune 7 for a desert stop and photos.

It is a balanced outing for guests who want both coastal-town character and open sand views. We take a maximum of four guests per vehicle, so the pace stays comfortable and you can ask as many questions as you like.

fields.title: Spitzkoppe Full-Day Tour from Swakopmund
fields.content:
Spitzkoppe is one of Namibia's most iconic granite landscapes, and this is the full-day option from Two Stars, led by Tuli and her women-led local team.

You get time to explore the famous rock formations, enjoy wide scenic views and learn about the area at a measured pace. With a maximum of four guests per vehicle, there is no crowd and no rush.

fields.title: Private Namib Coast Day: Design Your Own Route
fields.content:
Private tours let you shape the day: your own vehicle, your own timing and a route built around what you care about, whether that is photography, birdlife, dunes or a slower family day.

Tuli and her women-led local team plan the route with you. It works well for couples, families, photographers and cruise guests who need a day that fits a ship schedule. Tell us your date, group size and interests and we will confirm a plan and price.
